newsitem.title: HONG KONG: HK's Arts Optical ends debut at HK$2.25.
newsitem.headline: HK's Arts Optical ends debut at HK$2.25.

text.p: Shares of eye glass frame manufacturer Arts Optical International Holdings Ltd ended their Friday trading debut at HK$2.25 each, compared with their issue price of HK$1.00 per share.
"The rise was greater than we had expected," said ASG Investment analyst Michael Ng.
The stock opened at HK$1.70, its lowest level of the day, and hit an intra-day high of HK$2.475.
G.K. Goh Securities dealing manager Boby Ho, who had expected a price range of HK$1.8-2.0, attributed the strong price performance and brisk trade to speculative buying.
The third most active counter of the day in volume terms, Arts Optical saw 108.45 million shares changing hands on turnover of HK$239.56 million.
Arts Optical offered 84.5 million shares in Hong Kong at HK$1.00 per share of which the approximately 76 million shares available for public subscription was about 261 times subscribed.
The company said proceeds would be used to expand its production capacity, acquire licences for recognised brand names, repay bank loans and provide general working capital.
